detailed_descriptions.en: Rougelike Arcade Experience! Survive as long as you can, then spend your earnings to upgrade your ride and refine your build. Each run is a chance to go further, push your limits, and beat your previous best. Test your reflexes! Push your reflexes to the limit in a high-speed arcade driving experience where every second counts. Drift through traffic, dodge incoming chaos, and chain near-misses to keep your run alive. Procedurally Generated Maps! The city never stays the same. Roads shift, traffic patterns change, and every run throws new challenges your way. Stay focused, react fast, and keep the momentum going - because one mistake ends it all. Customizable Cars! Expand your garage with a lineup of unique cars - each with its own handling and flair. Personalise your ride with striking vinyls and stand out on every road. Hazards, traffic, weather effects, race modifiers! The longer you survive, the faster and more intense it gets. Tight gaps, sudden turns, and split-second decisions will push your skills to the edge. Crash, and it’s over. Start again, go further. Highscore chase and leaderboards! Compete for high scores, climb the leaderboards, and prove how far you can push your limits. No two runs are the same, and there’s always a higher score to chase.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Rougelike Arcade Experience!

Survive as long as you can, then spend your earnings to upgrade your ride and refine your build. Each run is a chance to go further, push your limits, and beat your previous best.

Test your reflexes!

Push your reflexes to the limit in a high-speed arcade driving experience where every second counts. Drift through traffic, dodge incoming chaos, and chain near-misses to keep your run alive.

Procedurally Generated Maps!

The city never stays the same. Roads shift, traffic patterns change, and every run throws new challenges your way. Stay focused, react fast, and keep the momentum going - because one mistake ends it all.

Customizable Cars!

Expand your garage with a lineup of unique cars - each with its own handling and flair. Personalise your ride with striking vinyls and stand out on every road.

Hazards, traffic, weather effects, race modifiers!

The longer you survive, the faster and more intense it gets. Tight gaps, sudden turns, and split-second decisions will push your skills to the edge. Crash, and it’s over. Start again, go further.

Highscore chase and leaderboards!

Compete for high scores, climb the leaderboards, and prove how far you can push your limits. No two runs are the same, and there’s always a higher score to chase.
